reels.caption:
The master bedroom ✨
Recently, we completed a 3BHK project in Mulund, where the master bedroom was designed thoughtfully using a beige and grey colour palette to create a modern and minimalist look. The wardrobe features openable shutters with sleek black handles, and an additional side section is dedicated to cloth storage, providing extra space for everyday wear and accessories.

A folding study table has been integrated into the room, accompanied by overhead storage units with a mix of profile shutters and plain shutters to organize essentials and display decor items. The headboard has also been designed in a matching beige and grey combination, tying the entire space together.

Overall, the combination of colours, materials, and clean lines gives the master bedroom a luxurious and elegant feel.
